shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure with head and body
curved parallel bands or bordered strips
head with elaborate hair or headdress treatment
justification: Both depict a schematic anthropomorphic figure rendered in bounded outline with plain interiors, and both scatter isolated circular discs across the figure's body/appendages together with curving banded strips, which is the most specific correspondence. However, A is a frontally conceived full-body figure whose back carries a symmetrical ring-and-girdle arrangement with no wings or attributes, while B is a strict profile figure with a large feathered wing, articulated hand, ear ornament and headdress engaged in an action pose elalational content that A entirely lacks.
